title: Run state
description: The orchestrator's working memory of one run: run-state.json at the root of the private store (design part 13.1). Derived, never authoritative: the ledger, the tracker, git branches and the decision items are the record, and hitld run rebuild reconstructs this file from them. ledger_position says which ledger events it has absorbed. Version 2 (HITLD-82) renamed open_questions to decisions_open, decisions_this_run to decisions_answered, held to held_for_digest and an in-flight entry's handle to harness_ref; a version 1 file is read in the new names until the next minor release.

run.description: Which run this is and what it started with.

in_flight.description: Each dispatch without a terminal event (reported, abandoned or unclaimed).

ledger_position.description: The ID of the last ledger event absorbed into this state; null before the first.

decisions_open.description: Decisions asked and not answered (was open_questions).

held_for_digest.description: Held for the next digest rather than sent at once.

decisions_answered.description: Answers received since the run started (was decisions_this_run).

controllers.description: Each controller's current setting and last step (design part 11.4). Not in the ledger, so a rebuild leaves it empty until the controllers next run.

quotas.description: The last usage snapshot and forecast (design part 12). Not in the ledger, so a rebuild leaves it null until the next snapshot.

merge_queue.description: Verified work waiting to merge, and the batch under test.

lease.description: Which orchestrator session holds the run.

checkpoint.description: This state's checkpoint number, and the hash of the previous checkpoint's state, so a rolled-back or edited history shows.

scope.description: What a run covers: items or milestones, its token budget, its concurrency cap and its stopping condition.

inFlight.description: One executor the orchestrator is waiting on.

harness_ref.description: The harness's reference; null until the harness has accepted the dispatch.
